title: Cinematic Golden Light Portrait
promptText: Cinematic close-up portrait of a young man in a white shirt, framed from mid-chest up, occupying most of the frame. His chest and shoulders are angled slightly toward the left side of the frame, while his face is turned toward the right side, looking slightly upward/right, with a calm, thoughtful expression. Messy textured dark hair. Behind him are hanging translucent crinkled cellophane/iridescent metallic foil sheets, creating a shimmering glass-like curtain with vertical folds, reflections and colorful prism highlights. Strong warm golden sunlight passes through the reflective sheets from the right, casting sharp broken leaf-like streaks of golden light and shadow across his face, neck and white shirt, while cool blue light fills the left side. Blue, cyan, purple and amber bokeh in the background, dreamy reflective atmosphere, shallow depth of field, highly detailed cinematic photography, natural skin texture, 4:5 portrait.
